description.en: An example extension from the Leo collection: what your agents and machines are doing, at a glance. Usage rings for each provider's 5-hour and weekly limits, the checks on your open pull requests and how busy each of your machines is, as a New Tab page and as a widget you place yourself. Opt in: nothing in cmux turns it on.
Usage rings, checks or machine load. Tap the title to switch.

scopes.chat:read: Read each chat's token and dollar usage of the last 24 hours and its account's 5-hour and weekly limits, as Claude Code and Codex recorded them. No credential, email or account name.
scopes.integration:github:read: Read the checks on your open pull requests through your GitHub sign-in. The token stays in cmux; this extension never sees it.
scopes.fleet:read: Read how busy each of your machines is (load, running agents), as acpmux reports it.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a cmux browser tab when you click it.

ci.title: Checks on my pull requests
ci.description: Off: no GitHub reads at all.
